test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 09 Jul, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.

We should not run after __transient__ pleasures of the world.
solution: The correct answer is: **Option 2.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word **"transient"** means something that lasts only for a short time; temporary. (क्षणिक) • **Example: **The transient nature of life makes every moment precious. • **"Permanent"** refers to something that lasts or remains unchanged indefinitely; enduring. (स्थायी) • **Example: **He found a permanent solution to the recurring problem. • Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'transient'** is **'permanent'**. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Permanent**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Sinful** (पापी): Involving or being guilty of immoral actions or behavior. • **Example:** He was punished for his sinful actions. • **Joyful** (खुश): Feeling, expressing, or causing great pleasure and happiness. • **Example:** The joyful celebration lasted all night. • **Unnatural** (अप्राकृतिक): Contrary to the ordinary course of nature; abnormal. • **Example:** The unnatural color of the sky worried the villagers. 51:T456,
